name: Point to point line
what: A diamond point pops up from below with its label and a footage card blurs in under it; the group then slides left while a line is drawn across to a second point, whose label and footage card come in under it, and everything settles.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f10 the first diamond pops up from below the frame (back-out, 13 % overshoot, scale 0.25 to 1), its label appears at f6; f15-f20 it rises 111 px (sine-out) and the first card blurs in at f20; f30-f40 the group slides left 373 px and shrinks to 95 % (sine in-out, motion-blurred) while the line is drawn out (f31-f35) to the second diamond, which fades in and slides to the right (f33-f40) with its label; the second card blurs in at f50; then a slow drift to the end

tracks.name: first point
tracks.what: the diamond pops up from below the frame and overshoots a little; its label appears at f6

tracks.name: rise
tracks.what: the first point rises 111 px to make room

tracks.name: first card
tracks.what: the footage card blurs in under the first point (2 frames)

tracks.name: slide
tracks.what: the first group slides left 373 px and shrinks to 95 %, smeared sideways

tracks.name: line
tracks.what: the line is drawn from the first point to the second

tracks.name: second point
tracks.what: the second diamond fades in and slides right to its place, its label with it

tracks.name: second card
tracks.what: the footage card blurs in under the second point (2 frames)

tracks.name: drift
tracks.what: a slow settle drift of a few pixels
